findings.claim: ATLAS (qwen2.5-7b-instruct) revised its strategy most often — 5 of 6 reflections produced a change.
BOREAS (gpt-oss-20b) held its strategy most often — 4 explicit no-change decisions.
CIPHER (deepseek-v3) showed the most self-reversal — 7 oscillations (a dial moved ≥0.15 then reversed by ≥0.15 within two updates).
ATLAS (qwen2.5-7b-instruct) had the largest second-half improvement (+10 chips/hand vs. its own first half). Directional only — six hands is not a sample.
CIPHER (deepseek-v3) moved its dials the furthest in total (4.95 absolute movement across all three dials).
2 reflections failed mechanically (malformed JSON or timeout) and the affected strategies were left untouched; the tournament continued.
